text: So in that case, there is no access point, but the Wi-Fi wireless cards, so the Wi-Fi stations, can communicate with each other directly. This is not very popular in Wi-Fi, right? We are used to the other network architecture, the one with access point. That's what we use daily. But it is a possible network architecture. For example, in particular scenarios, environments, like mines, right? In mines, when you need to connect different wireless Wi-Fi nodes, this is the typical network architecture that you use in that case. Or when you have emergency squads. So you have an emergency squad. Each member of the squad has got a Wi-Fi device. In the case of emergency squads, they communicate directly using this network architecture. Why? Because they operate in an emergency. So the infrastructure may be disrupted, destroyed by a earthquake, flooding, other kind of emergencies. So in that case, there are no access points available, and the members of the emergency squad.
